title: A/R Collection: the Location list changes with the as-of date
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in this report at {Location-A} and {Location-B} on today's date; {Location-B} had none on {Date-A}.
    For example: {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310; {Date-A} is a date before {Location-B}'s first open invoice.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  2. Click the Location chip and read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report reloads for {Date-A}.
  • Step 2: the list changes with the as-of date: {Location-B} is no longer offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R3: “The list offers every location at which the organization has open documents in this report on the as-of date, whatever location the user is signed into and whatever locations they are enrolled in. It is not narrowed by the Location filter, the customer or vendor filter, or the Past due filter; it changes only with the as-of date.”
